affine_transport_classifier.balance: with h<=2H and |qE-a|<=C1/(KX), the extra strip constant is at most 2*H*y_upper*C1/(aK)
affine_transport_classifier.boundary: This is a single cross-label edge classifier. It supplies neither a target-local Cycle-67 packet nor an E7/E9 recurrence.
affine_transport_classifier.deconvolution: P(N)<=binom(|N|,4), so parent multiplicity gives a fourth-root distinct-parameter lower bound only
affine_transport_classifier.eligibility: a|h0+r n is soluble iff gcd(a,r)|h0 and then one residue class is intersected with both exact row ranges
affine_transport_classifier.rigidity: within the reduced rational ansatz B=q/a and j_plus=j+A h, error factorization uniquely forces A=1-q/a; coprimality makes integrality equivalent to a|h
affine_transport_classifier.transport: the exact target residual equals the source residual minus h*y*(qE-a)/a

claim_boundary: Within the one-step affine multiplicative architecture, this classifies beta-preserving cross-label edges. It proves no eligible actual Cycle-166 fibre, target-local packet, recurrence, E7/E9 skeleton, density, or interval gain.

independence_countermodels.statement: Finite exact affine fibres separately realize residue failure, transformed-range failure, and unbounded balance; parent multiplicity alone cannot force direct transport in this architecture.

prior_context.cycle166_role: provides conditional massed beta-anchored shift/packet webs but not distinct-anchor eligibility
prior_context.cycle67_role: requires a genuine target-local packet and seed; a cross-label edge alone is insufficient

remaining_target.statement: Join an eligible cross-label edge to a retained target-local packet, or construct a labelled closed transport loop that yields an equivalent local relation while preserving beta and all range labels.
